subject: design/implement-now-issue-entry
statement: Add one consumer-owned exact-issue reader contract implemented by the existing tracker adapters. Its typed snapshot returns native identity, title/body, cited source comments, executable/open state, and native dependency identities/states. GitHub and Forgejo reject pull-request objects. Carina rejects closed/non-executable/rollup items and uses the same native dependency semantics as its ready command.
